title: Database-Backed Module Profile v1
summary: A module whose public behavior depends on database schemas, models, queries, policies, transactions, migrations, and seed data.

integration_points.name: storage_shape
integration_points.description: Database objects, versions, and migration path.

integration_points.name: data_safety
integration_points.description: Permissions, tenant boundaries, consistency, and retry behavior.

checks: Database schema and application data model are both discoverable.
Public queries declare parameters, results, permissions, and limits.
Migrations declare ordering, effects, safety, and rollback or irreversibility.
Sensitive fields and tenant-scoped objects have access policy references.
Seed data and backups are safe for their declared environments.

agent_guidance: Use this profile for modules that own persistent application data.
Do not add repository methods without updating query surface and access policy descriptors.
Treat migrations, transaction boundaries, and seed data as integration surfaces.
